description: Branch R-FMT-1 FMT1-CALCULATED and R-FMT-2 Calculated wrappers (public side), the part the first card could not ask because its Text and Date expressions (CStr, DateAdd with a # literal) were refused with 3859. On an ACCDB, one table CT<name>(ID Long, A Long, B Text(20), D Date, C calculated) per expression, made through CreateTableDef with Expression put before the field is appended, each step's Errors read after a marker. Text results: [B] & "-calc" (the form the earlier fixture admitted), [B] & "-" & [A], UCase([B]), Left([B], 1), Format([A], "000"), and CStr([A]) as the control that was refused; a Memo result [B] & "x"; Date results: [D] + 1, #1/1/2000# + [A], DateAdd("d", [A], [D]) with double-quoted interval, DateSerial(2000, 1, [A]), Date(). Rows (5, 'xy', 2000-01-01) and a row of Nulls are written through a recordset and read back, and C's Type, Size, Attributes and properties (Expression, ResultType) are read. Asks which Text, Memo and Date results ACE admits as calculated columns, which expressions it refuses, and what each reads back.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
